layout: Native entry content padding2; StringWidget at getContentXMiddle()-font.width(label)/2 and getContentYMiddle()-9/2 using integer division. Single-line text remains unwrapped even beyond entry bounds.
slots: EmptyHeader/Media/Content layout is a web composition; EmptyTitle and EmptyDescription reproduce Label glyphs, wrapping and alignment. Default media only; no invented icon variants.
scope: 96 native ASCII empty-row cases: four labels including blank/overflow, widths101/200, heights20/41, two backgrounds and GUI scales1–3. Additional84 originalLabelcases are compared through each Title/Description slot, including CJK, wrapping and alignment. Whole composed empty-state screens and arbitrary rich children do not have a native equality claim.
